title: codonopsis thalictrifolia subsp. mollis
intro: Codonopsis thalictrifolia subsp. mollis, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Campanulaceae family, is native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Codonopsis thalictrifolia subsp. mollis include tonifying the spleen and lungs, promoting digestion, and enhancing the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, saponins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
